paragraphs.text: Ittono Khairt ni Hata Kan was a wrestler from Oneah on Dominaria , who became a knight .
According to the Onean tradition, Ittono was his family name, Khairt was his personal-name, and ni Hata Kan signified that he trained as a wrestler under master Telina Hata .

Khairt was very large, with black hair and a ragged scar on his cheek. He had brown tree bark tattooed on his legs, colorful bird tattoos on his chest, and flower tattoos on his arms. He wore black chainmail over black clothes and was heavily armored from head to toe. He rode a great black charger due to constant knee pain when on foot. He carried a broadsword and shield.

Khairt was the Grand Champion of Master Telina Hata 's wrestling school. Rooting his legs to the ground, he had been immovable in wrestling matches until his final match, in which he fought on after a body blow to his knee, and a second body blow to his other knee ended his career, leaving him in pain for the rest of his life. During the Fall of Oneah in 4165 AR, he stood in Xa-On and faced down the hordes of goblins along with his master and his other colleagues, including Istini Ayesh ni Hata Kan . As the monks started falling one by one, Ayesh witnessed Khairt fall from a blow to his head. Thinking him dead, Ayesh hid in a grate beneath the Roof of Lights. She was stuck there for days, and in the meantime, Khairt came to and found all his companions slain. So it came to pass that both Khairt and Ayesh survived, each thinking themself the sole survivor.

Afterward, Khairt wandered, finding a new master to teach him the art of broadsword. Traveling north, he reached Amjad , where he found employment as a knight working for the land's eponymous king . He covered his tattooed body with black armor and was forced to work with the flamboyant assassin Daisilodavi , whom he hated for his flowery and frivolous nature. The assassin likewise hated Khairt back for his blunt anger and no-nonsense attitude. Some years after the Fall of Oneah, the king sent Khairt with Daisilodavi to the Heart of Shanodin to murder Lord Glinham , a defector who had refused to pay his dues to the king.

While in Shanodin, Khairt became enchanted by the magic of the Heart, which revealed each person's true self. Khairt removed his armor and bathed in the stream, staring dreamily at the beauty of the forest and falling in love with a Shanodin dryad . His dream ended when Daisilodavi, having finished the business of assassinating Lord Glinham, broke the spell on Khairt by murdering the dryad. Though Khairt was shocked and repulsed by this action, he did not retaliate against the assassin, knowing it would be a fight he would likely lose, but still he refused to return to Amjad. Daisilodavi then professed to Khairt that he felt something more for the knight than animosity. Though surprised at this, Khairt found himself feeling a reciprocation, revealed to him by the Heart of Shanodin. Together, the two of them left the forest, riding back to the dark lands of Amjad, but now with a new bond forged between them.
